tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer & Techno-Functional E-Commerce Expert
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce specialist with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large-scale enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in requirements analysis, process mapping, user stories, product catalog management, RESTful APIs, microservices and agile workflows using Jira and Confluence. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner (Digital Commerce)
cover_en.hook: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional delivery experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell to PLUS Retail's digital customer channels. Driving complex platform solutions, aligning business needs with technical execution, and collaborating with international stakeholders are at the core of my daily work.

bullets.label: Requirements & Backlog Alignment
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders at Rockwell Automation to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Data-Driven Analysis & Optimization
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams at Shell, mapped processes, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) and system stability.

bullets.label: Technical Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between ERP and PIM platforms, working directly with international technical teams to ensure seamless data flows and platform performance.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Tooling
bullets.text: Operated within fast-paced Agile and Scrum environments using Jira and Confluence for sprint planning, tracking development initiatives, and managing cross-functional technical deliverables.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional e-commerce expertise aligns with your digital product goals.

tailoring.why_company: PLUS Retail stands out for its strong commitment to shaping digital customer experiences that impact thousands of users daily. I am inspired by your focus on scaling innovative app, web, and e-commerce platforms. My deep background in enterprise digital solutions, stakeholder alignment, and agile delivery enables me to effectively bridge business objectives with technical execution to drive meaningful product value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, techno-functional analysis, and cross-functional agile delivery experience to help PLUS Retail scale its digital customer channels.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, strong experience bridging business needs with technical teams, and Agile expertise in Jira/Confluence, I would love to contribute to PLUS Retail's digital channels. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner (Digital Commerce) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner (Digital Commerce) position at PLUS Retail.

With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions, driving requirements engineering, and collaborating with international business and technical stakeholders in Agile environments, I am well-prepared to add immediate value to your digital team.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your product goals.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
